about_hero_description: We didn't just build another blocker. We built an engine for behavioral change. Ace Blocker is designed to break the cycle of internet addiction at the source.
about_mission_description: Internet addiction isn't about a lack of willpower; it's about systems designed to exploit your biology. We build tools that fight back, giving you the upper hand in the battle for your attention.
about_tech_description: Under the hood, Ace Blocker uses a high-performance, system-wide proxy engine that ensures nothing slips through the cracks.
about_feature_system_description: Unlike simple browser extensions, Ace Blocker operates at the network level. This means it protects your entire system—apps, games, and every browser you use.
about_feature_intel_description: Our engine handles millions of site rules in real-time using high-performance database technology, allowing for instant filtering without slowing down your connection.
about_feature_scripts_description: Blocking isn't always the answer. Resistance Mode makes addictive sites less appealing by dynamically adding friction to them, breaking the habit loop at the source.
about_feature_locks_description: Set it and forget it. Lock your schedules to ensure that when your willpower dips, your protection remains absolute and tamper-proof.
